content: Free 'cpu-basic' HF Space hardware: 2 vCPU, 16GB RAM, 50GB ephemeral disk. Free Spaces go to sleep after a period of inactivity (community reports vary, historically ~48h without traffic); next visitor after sleep triggers a cold start (community-reported 30-90s) during which the app is unreachable/loading. Community forum threads (2026) report CPU-Basic Spaces still hitting undocumented quota/runtime limits despite 'unlimited hosting' framing, with inconsistent behavior on Restart vs Factory Rebuild.
